data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2791 experienced a gross back year release of GBP 20.4m in 2023, primarily driven by favorable claims development in long-tail casualty classes, the short-tail account, and the auto account for 2019 and 2020 years. This was also influenced by the resolution of an outstanding dispute related to Superstorm Sandy (2012) and the removal of specific IBNR for 2019 events like Hurricane Dorian and Japanese windstorms due to claims stability. However, 2020 wind events (Hurricane Laura, Sally, Derecho) experienced some deterioration, partially mitigated by reinsurance recoveries. The syndicate continues to manage exposures to Hurricane Ida (2021), Winter Storm Uri (2021), Hurricane Ian (2022), and COVID-19 pandemic losses, with some of these events showing net losses or projected ultimate losses.
